description: PARTIAL SAVE: writes ONLY the 'Multiplayer' field of TitlePublicConfigurationModel; all other v1/v2 fields stay untouched. Realtime multiplayer (WebRTC peer-to-peer) - the engine is only the signaling server: it creates rooms, relays WebRTC offer/answer/ICE between room members and optionally relays lobby chat; game traffic then flows directly between players' browsers and never touches the server. The section is ABSENT by default, which means multiplayer is DISABLED: add it (SystemState.Enabled = true) to turn the Multiplayer module on. DefaultTopology: Mesh (everyone connects to everyone, 2-4 players) or Host (star: every player connects to the host, which runs the authoritative game simulation - required by host-authoritative games such as VoxelCraft). MaxPlayersPerRoom is a hard cap (default 8). MemberTimeoutMs is also how long a silent host keeps the host role before another member may take it over. IceServers are PUBLIC: list only STUN servers there; short-lived TURN credentials are issued by the engine to room members on create/join.

IceServer.description: A single ICE server (maps to RTCIceServer on the client).

value.description: V2 definition of the title's realtime multiplayer (WebRTC signaling). Public-only data: feature switch, topology/chat defaults, limits, ICE servers.

AllowCreatorChatOverride.description: Whether the room creator may override the chat mode at creation time.

AllowCreatorTopologyOverride.description: Whether the room creator may override the topology at creation time.

DefaultChatMode.description: Default chat mode: ServerRelay (chat goes through the server, works in the lobby) or P2P (chat goes over the players' own DataChannel, the server does not relay it).

DefaultTopology.description: Default p2p connection topology for rooms: Mesh (everyone connects to everyone, small rooms) or Host (star: every player connects only to the host, which runs the authoritative simulation).

HeartbeatIntervalMs.description: Recommended client poll interval (ms) while players are connecting.

IceServers.description: Extra ICE servers returned to the client verbatim. PUBLIC data: put only STUN servers here (or a TURN server whose credentials you are fine publishing). Short-lived TURN credentials are issued by the engine itself to room members. Empty = default public STUN servers.

MaxPlayersPerRoom.description: Max players per room (hard cap; the creator may request fewer).

MaxRoomLifetimeSeconds.description: Hard room lifetime in seconds since creation. Unlike RoomTtlSeconds, activity does NOT renew it. When it passes the room is closed (members receive RoomClosed with Kind "expired"). Read from the current config. 0 = no limit.

MaxSignalPayloadBytes.description: Max size of a single WebRTC signal payload (bytes). Guards against Redis bloat.

MemberTimeoutMs.description: Threshold (ms) since the last heartbeat after which a member is treated as offline. Also the threshold after which another member may take over the host role of a room whose host stopped responding.

RecordVoices.description: Whether OTHER players' voices are included in videos a player records on the platform. On by default (the game then shows a 'Conversations may be recorded' notice); off = only the game sound and the recording player's own voice. Read by the client SDK (the multiplayer module), not by the server: videos are recorded in the player's browser.

RoomLogCap.description: How many most-recent broadcast envelopes to keep in the room log (tail trimming).

RoomTtlSeconds.description: Room key TTL in Redis (seconds). Renewed on every interaction; the room disappears after this many idle seconds.

VoiceEnabled.description: Voice chat in rooms. On by default; the room creator may turn it off for their room. Voice goes peer-to-peer in the same connection as game data (the server never sees it).
